test.create_query: CREATE TABLE filtered_deserialization_perf ( id UInt64, k UInt32, arr Array(UInt32) CODEC(LZ4), arr_nullable Array(Nullable(UInt64)) CODEC(LZ4), m Map(UInt32, UInt64) CODEC(LZ4) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192, min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 0, ratio_of_defaults_for_sparse_serialization = 1, map_serialization_version = 'basic', map_serialization_version_for_zero_level_parts = 'basic'
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO filtered_deserialization_perf SELECT number, cityHash64(number) % 1000, range(number % 60), arrayMap(x -> if(x % 3 = 0, NULL, x), range(number % 20)), mapFromArrays(range(number % 10), range(number % 10)) FROM numbers(10000000)
test.query: SELECT sum(cityHash64(arr)) FROM filtered_deserialization_perf PREWHERE k < 10 SETTINGS max_threads = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(cityHash64(arr_nullable)) FROM filtered_deserialization_perf PREWHERE k < 10 SETTINGS max_threads = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(cityHash64(m)) FROM filtered_deserialization_perf PREWHERE k < 10 SETTINGS max_threads = 1 FORMAT Null
